preDeployCommand: sh -c 'python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.validate_runtime --service web --create-schema && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.prepare_rnsrepo_public && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.audit_production --service web --record --reconcile-stale --reconcile-publication --historical-worker-failures-warn && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.release_acceptance --require-public-data && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.monitoring_acceptance --require-public-data && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.company_acceptance --require-public-data && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.daily_editor_acceptance --require-public-data && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.newsroom_acceptance --require-public-data && python -m jobs.quiet_predeploy jobs.radar_acceptance && if [ "$RNSREPO_DEPLOY_LIVE_CHECK" = "1" ]; then timeout 45s python -m jobs.check_rnsrepo_card --live --output /tmp/rnsrepo-deployment-check.json; fi && if [ "$RNSREPO_PASS3_EVAL" = "compare-v1" ]; then timeout 840s python -u -m jobs.evaluate_rnsrepo --live --output /tmp/rnsrepo-eval.json; fi && if [ "$RNSREPO_PASS3_EVAL" = "compare-v2" ]; then timeout 840s python -u -m jobs.evaluate_rnsrepo --live --models gpt-5-mini,gpt-5.4-nano --output /tmp/rnsrepo-eval.json; fi && if [ "$RNSREPO_PASS3_EVAL" = "repair-v3" ]; then timeout 420s python -u -m jobs.evaluate_rnsrepo --live --models gpt-5-mini --output /tmp/rnsrepo-eval.json; fi'
